d: Donald Trump promised Republicans a midterm victory. Instead, Democrats swept the House and Senate, delivering a major political setback to his presidency. From rising living costs and the Iran war to immigration controversies and allegations of corruption, voters delivered their verdict. And Trump's reaction? A Truth Social blame game, a claim that he would have won in a landslide, and a sudden willingness to work with Democrats. As Republicans begin questioning their own leader, is Trump's political grip slipping? Firstpost examines the election fallout, MAGA's troubles and what this…
